haherrenhausen.name: Herrenhausen Gardens
haherrenhausen.slogan: Baroque hedges, clipped straight, and a fountain that shoots skyward.
haherrenhausen.line: The Great Fountain can leap up to 80 metres, and in 1721 it was already the highest in any European court.

haneuesrathaus.name: New Town Hall
haneuesrathaus.slogan: A copper dome you ride up in a lift that bends.
haneuesrathaus.line: Opened in 1913, it stands on 6,026 beech piles, and its dome lift follows a curved track, unique in the world.

hadom.name: Hildesheim Cathedral
hadom.slogan: Bronze doors from the year 1015 and a rose older than the legend.
hadom.line: Its rose bush is believed to be the oldest living rose in the world, said to date back to 815.

hafagus.name: Fagus Factory
hafagus.slogan: Glass corners and brick, where modern architecture took its first steps.
hafagus.line: Gropius and Meyer built this shoe-last factory in 1911-1913; it became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2011.

harattenfaengerhaus.name: Pied Piper House
harattenfaengerhaus.slogan: The house where the piper's story is carved into the facade.
harattenfaengerhaus.line: Hamelin Town's in Brunswick, / By famous Hanover city.
harattenfaengerhaus.by: Robert Browning, The Pied Piper of Hamelin, 1842
